introduction: Connecticut unemployment claims are managed in ReEmployCT. A new claim and an ongoing weekly certification are different actions in the system.
description: Connecticut unemployment claims are managed in ReEmployCT. A new claim and an ongoing weekly certification are different actions in the system.

sections.who: The Department of Labor assesses recent wages, job separation and ongoing eligibility. Continue to follow work-search and earnings-reporting instructions for the claim.
sections.get: Qualifying claims receive temporary unemployment payments. An account or submitted application is not an approval.
sections.docs:
• Employment dates, employer details and wage records.
  • The reason work ended or hours changed.
  • Identity and payment information requested by ReEmployCT.
sections.apply:
1. Start the correct claim action

    Use the DOL unemployment page to reach ReEmployCT. Old-system users need a ReEmployCT account.

  2. File weekly certifications

    For an active continuous claim, choose Weekly Certification in Quick Links. Report wages when earned, following the state instructions.

  3. Get help through the contact center

    Use DOL’s callback scheduler or online case option for account and filing problems. Check claim messages for requests.
sections.after: Save claim confirmations and read determinations. Weekly certification is required separately from starting a claim.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using ReEmployCT claimant instructions; DOL claim services and contact center. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Do I file a new claim each week?
No. Use Weekly Certification for an active continuous claim.
Can I use an old-system username?
DOL says users of the old unemployment system need a ReEmployCT account.
The state directs filers to report wages as earned.
Use the Consumer Contact Center resources or callback scheduler; appeals staff do not handle technical filing problems.
